title.narrative: Metropolitan Sanitation Management Investment Project

description.narrative: The Project will provide improved urban wastewater services in the cities of Cimahi, Jambi, Makassar, Palembang, and Pekanbaru in the Republic of Indonesia. These cities currently lack any piped sewerage and wastewater treatment facilities. The Project will respond to the needs of urban communities, including low-income households, by constructing new separate sewerage systems and wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), setting up local wastewater infrastructure management institutions and strengthening the relevant departments of respective regional governments.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3123: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 09 May 2025
Loan 8280: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 09 May 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: In April 2024, ADB approved a minor change on outcome indicator description as follows: 26,100 domestic property connections (Serving 130,500 persons) and 6,200 commercial property connections identified and have access to be connected to the central sewerage system. By the closing date, a total of 24,732 potential domestic property connections (94.75%) and 10,453 potential commercial property connections (168.59%) are identified in the sewer service area. The total number of identified potential connections at 35,185 is above target. As many as 469 domestic property connections (64 connections serve poor households for which 34 households are female headed households) and 69 commercial property connections are installed and connected to the central sewerage system. 293 community-based sanitation system completed (above the target at 64 systems). A total of 631,962 households (HHs) are served through desludging service (above the target at 121,000 HHs). It is concluded that all outcome indicators are achieved. The project has been closed on 30 June 2024.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43251/43251-025-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Oct 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43251/43251-025-iee-en.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | May 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43251/43251-025-rp-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Feb 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43251/43251-025-sddr-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43251/43251-025-smr-en_21.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: All project output indicators are achieved. A total of 191.33 km of sewerage network were installed in Jambi, Makassar, and Pekanbaru (above the target at 159.4 km). WWTPs were built in three cities, with the maximum capacity as designed: 7.6 MLD in Jambi, 16 MLB in Makassar, and 8.1 MLD in Pekanbaru. 39.76% of construction workers are local (above the target at 35%). Wastewater tariff regulation indicate that poor households and households headed by women are classified as beneficiaries with the lowest tariff. Public consultation on sewerage connections was held with women accounting for 36% of participants (above the target 30%). Gender-disaggregated indicators have been integrated in the project performance monitoring system an regularly monitored through gender action plan regular monitoring. Women representation in the management positions is 63% in EA, 33% in IA, and 27% in the Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah (UPTD). In aggregate, the increase of women representation rate meets the target at 10%. Capacity building activities on hygiene promotion, education, planning and participatory monitoring completed with 36.7% participation of women (above the target at 30%). The project has been closed on 30 June 2024.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/43251-025/main#project-tenders
